verdict.rationale: Opting out of usage tracking is a fair question for an online legal-services platform with user accounts and dashboards, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of telemetry, analytics, or cookie opt-out controls. The only privacy-related item is about listing LegalZoom's address as registered agent on public records, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
